comment: I love Dr. Ng! I wish I could take every single class he offers! He is really funny, really cares about his students, and leads really riveting class discussions! My favorite professor ever!

Dr. Ng is easily one of the most supportive professors I have ever had at UR. He is so kind, accommodating, and fair in the way that he assigns homework and papers. Course is made up of discussion questions, response papers, a midterm exam, and a final paper. His experience as a student really makes a difference in the way that he teaches. LOVE HIM
